title: DeviceCommand
description: Downlink message from the Pi to the ESP32, one JSON object per line, see protocol.md. The engine publishes it on device.command without seq. The bridge stamps seq and overwrites ts with the write time immediately before the line goes on the wire, where seq is mandatory. Every field is explicit on the wire, there are no device side defaults.

Seq.title: Seq
Seq.description: Per-direction frame counter of the serial link. Starts at 1 when the link opens, increases by 1 for every frame sent in that direction, wraps from 4294967295 to 1.

QueryWhat.title: QueryWhat
QueryWhat.description: sensors asks for an immediate sensor_report, state asks for the actuator state in the ack, info asks for a new hello.

SetZoneLight.description: Fade one zone to a brightness.

ts.description: Send time, ISO 8601 UTC. The device sets its clock from it.

cmd_id.description: Command id echoed by the ack.
